physicsTracePolicy: Production input samples at 120 Hz. After X/G/E/Q/1/2, trace until both 20 s wall time and 20 s simulation time have elapsed. The 2400-event rolling capacity still applies and discarded events are counted. Actual poses, body-axis travel, authority and action receipts are distinct from controller references.

pilotIntent.scope: Accepted controller request only. Saturation, valve lag, finite supply and contact can prevent the requested motion.

attitudeTravel.scope: Actual quaternion increments in the previous body frame. Signed/absolute axis travel is not an Euler angle or proof of a clean single-axis 360-degree maneuver.
